main_text.p: לשון c. sed fœm. sæpius, Lingua : Metonymicè Sermo : & Metaphoricè ad vária transfertur: ut, Lingua maris, pro Sinu, Josh.15.2. Lingua auri, pro Lingula aurea, Josh.7.21. Lingua ignis; pro Flamma extrema in speciem linguæ se protendente, Jes.5.24. Constr. דבק לשון ים Linguam sive sinum maris, Jesa.11.15. לשון יונק Adhaeret linguæ lactentis, Thr.4.4. ubi masc. est. Sic cum Aff. ולשוני אם־יהוה Et lingua mea si eloquetur, Job.27.v.4. Plural. מריב לשונות A' contentione linguarum, Psal.31.21. Aff. ללשונתם Secundum linguas suas, Genes.10.20. Chald. לשן Lingua, pro Populo cujuscunque linguæ aut sermonis, Dan.3.29. Plural. לשניא Linguæ, v.4.

לושן Pih. Detrahere, Calumniari. Partic. מלושני Linguâ ladens, vel Detrahens, aut Calumniantes, Psalm.101.5. cum ' paragogico. Hiph. Futur. תלשן Linguâ offendas, Insimules[?], Calumnieris aut Deferas, Prov.30.10.
לתח מלתחות f. Vestiarium, 2.Reg.10.22. Targum קמשרא Arca.
לתך m. Semichomer sive Semicorus, mensura continens quinq;[?] ephas, Hof.3.2.

לתע Niph. נלתע Commoli. Præter. cum defectu primæ radicalis, נתעו Commoluntur, Job.4.10. מלתעות f.p. Molares dentes: Constr. מלתעות Psal.58. v.7. quod & literis transpositis dicitur מתלעות Joel.1.6. unde Aff. מתלעותיו Molares ejus, Prov.30.14.
מואב Moab, Nomen proprium filii Lot, Genes.19.37. Inde, מואבי m. Moabita, Deut.23.3. Plural.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic vowel points are only partly legible at this scan resolution and are given as the consonantal forms seen. Uncertain readings are marked [?]: "Insimules" (the printed word is blurred), "quinq;" (the abbreviation), and "קמשרא". The printed reference "Hof.3.2" is left as printed, though Hos. is meant. Latin italics are approximated from the scan. The running head is the Hebrew range printed at the top right.
